summary: Build reliable, idempotent data pipelines with contracts, quality checks and safe backfills.
intents: design an incremental load from postgres to our warehouse
our nightly etl job creates duplicate rows
add data quality checks before the dashboard tables refresh
backfill six months of events without double counting
write a data contract for the orders feed
the pipeline breaks whenever the source adds a column
verify: Reruns of the same window produce the same result
Quality checks run before data is published
